metadata.title: देसी मुर्गा और मुनगा फूल की सब्ज़ी | Desi Chicken and Munga Phool Curry | Jharkhandi Food
metadata.description: In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we journeyed to the scenic Gumla district of Jharkhand to connect with the Oraon tribe. Our exploration brought us to a warm and welcoming family who shared their rich cultural heritage and culinary traditions. Together, we prepared two exquisite dishes: Desi Chicken, known for its robust and earthy flavours, and Mungal Phool Curry, a unique delicacy made with local ingredients. This episode celebrates the Oraon tribe's vibrant food culture, emphasising the deep connection between their traditional cuisine and the land they cherish.
